traits.name: Capable
traits.description: The expert has a utility expertise in one profession, and they gain an advantage on skill tests related to that profession.

traits.name: Stern Countenance
traits.description: After the expert spends focus to resist a character's influence, that character loses 1 focus.

actions.name: Counter Argument
actions.description: During a conversation, the expert makes a Persuasion test against a character's Spiritual defense. On a success, the target loses 3 focus.

strikes.name: Improvised Weapon
strikes.description: Attack +2, reach 5 ft., one target. On a Complication, this improvised weapon breaks. Graze: 2 (1d4) impact damage. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 2) impact damage.
